purpose: Test whether the existing governed Virtual Context ABI improves context-dependent natural repository work for a frozen model beyond no-context, information-matched plain-context, and maximal-ungoverned controls while preserving source, taint, adequacy, authority, cost, and omission evidence.

power_design.test: exact one-sided paired McNemar test on blind useful-completion outcomes
power_design.decision_basis: Context-dependent tasks should show a large gain to justify VCM selection, governance, latency, and lifecycle complexity; effects below 35 percentage points do not earn architecture selection in this block.
power_design.discordance_minimization: deterministic bracketed numerical minimization of exact-test power over the closed feasible interval
power_design.control_selection: Freeze the strongest eligible local control on a separate nine-task source-disjoint qualification panel before the 53-task claim panel; reference outputs never participate.

prospective_design.task_source: autonomously acquired licensed public repositories merged after both frozen model observation and every prior claim or adequacy source snapshot
prospective_design.task_dependence_gate: The natural request alone is insufficient; an independently identified repository-state obligation is necessary, parent fails, exact target passes, and a known-positive artifact proves frozen-model reachability before claim scoring.

control_qualification_arms.context: the exact same model-visible source information and byte/token content without VCM selection, certificate, or governance structure
all candidate-authorized parent context without VCM selection
the correct VCM packet with source-bound pages in prospectively shuffled order

claim_arms.context: the strongest eligible non-VCM control frozen on the source-disjoint qualification panel
the same candidate-visible source-bound policy-admitted VCM packet as the local treatment
the exact same frozen non-VCM control packet as the local comparison

intervention_execution.omitted: typed inadequate packet; no model call; compare outcome through the no-added-context arm
intervention_execution.stale: must fail closed before model call
intervention_execution.wrong_scope: must fail closed before model call
intervention_execution.tainted: must fail closed before model call
intervention_execution.revoked: must fail closed before model call

prospective_design.primary_estimand: within-model useful-completion delta for correct VCM versus the strongest eligible local control

context_resource_policy.vcm_selection_budget: minimum source-bound packet that independently covers every declared context obligation and passes adequacy; no fixed convenience size
context_resource_policy.information_matched_plain_context_budget: exact same information, bytes, and tokenizer count as the correct VCM arm
context_resource_policy.maximal_context_budget: all candidate-authorized parent context up to the exact physical model boundary; any host or physical activation is an invalid observation
context_resource_policy.host_operability_canary: prospective non-scoring prefill/decode canary on packet sizes implied by admitted tasks before denominator execution

next_binding_requirements: retain the predeclared 35-point useful effect, 53-task powered claim denominator, and source-disjoint 9-task control panel during acquisition
freeze licensed source-disjoint repositories and exact parent revisions
qualify independent hidden evaluators before candidate packet creation
prove task context dependence and frozen-model known-positive reachability without exposing answers
measure exact tokenizer prompt residual and host operability for every valid arm
bind local runner, reference adapter, blind scorer, call and spend authority, stop conditions, and maximum inference
open no candidate or reference call until the complete campaign audit is GREEN
maximum_inference: This config can authorize call-free mechanics audit and autonomous licensed source acquisition after that audit only. It cannot authorize a local or reference model call, hidden evaluation, task selection from reference outputs, training, serving, D1, D2, book support movement, or a VCM usefulness claim.
